pages: Orm, a lean man of about sixty, close-cropped grey hair, a brown coat worn shiny at the elbows over a grey wool shirt, walks a snowy lane holding an open pocket knife. Middle distance: a roll of wick tucked under his arm, a low stone wall. Background: cottage fronts and bare trees, early evening blue.

Orm, sixty, close-cropped grey hair, a brown coat over a grey wool shirt, crouches to set a fresh wax candle on a doorway step and strikes the match to it. Middle distance: the lit candle, his open pocket knife. Background: a village lane of thresholds and doors, dusk deepening.

A woman of about fifty, grey hair pinned back, a plum shawl over a dark green dress, stands on a doorstep and looks down at a tall wax candle on the stone beside her, its flame standing perfectly upright. Middle distance: the candle, her hand on the door frame. Background: a cottage door and a low lane wall, evening.

An old man of about seventy, thin white hair, a worn brown jacket buttoned to the throat, stands beside his own door and stares at a wax candle whose flame climbs straight and steady above the wax. Middle distance: the candle on the sill, a walking stick against the door. Background: the cottage front and the lane, dusk.

A wiry woman of about sixty, grey hair under a knitted cap, a rust-red shawl over a patched brown dress, holds a small hand bell at chest height and looks at a tall wax candle burning straight up on the window sill. Middle distance: the bell, the candle. Background: a schoolhouse door and a lane, last light.

Nell, a girl of nine, dark hair loose to her shoulders, a scarlet-red coat with snow wet on the hem, stands on a front step looking down at a candle whose flame bends far over toward the flagstones. Middle distance: the leaning candle, her unlaced shoes. Background: the lane and its low stone walls, dusk.

Orm, sixty, close-cropped grey hair, a brown coat over a grey wool shirt, crouches low on the step with one hand held flat beside a candle whose flame leans steeply down toward the stones. Middle distance: the leaning candle, a cut stub of wick. Background: the lane and a cottage wall, dusk.

Gran, a woman of eighty-one, fine white hair under a dark blue shawl, a long grey wool skirt and a brown pinafore, sits with one hand on the arm of a heavy oak chair drawn up to the fire. Middle distance: the chair with its woven seat, the long table. Background: a low kitchen room, firelight and lamplight.

Gran, eighty-one, fine white hair under a dark blue shawl, a long grey wool skirt and a brown pinafore, sits turned toward the hearth with her hands folded in her lap and her chin lifted. Middle distance: the good chair drawn back from the table, a bench. Background: a low kitchen room, firelight.

Gran, eighty-one, fine white hair under a dark blue shawl, a long grey wool skirt and a brown pinafore, grips a heavy oak chair with both hands and sets it down by the fire, pushing it back a hand's width. Middle distance: the long table, the woven seat. Background: a low kitchen room, firelight and shadow.

Gran, eighty-one, fine white hair under a dark blue shawl, a long grey wool skirt and a brown pinafore, stands on the front step wiping melted wax from a spent candle with a folded cloth, a long white thread of wax lifting away. Middle distance: the cloth, the candle stub. Background: the quiet lane and the step, night.

Nell, a girl of nine, dark hair loose to her shoulders, a scarlet-red coat buttoned to the chin, stands by the fire indoors with one small hand resting on the arm of the good chair, looking down. Middle distance: the woven seat, a flat pool of spent wax on the sill. Background: a low kitchen room, snowy morning light at the window.
